objective: 核心方法复现＋小规模效果验证，并交付教学实验报告
scope_label: 协议一致性修正版小规模复现，非全论文原样数值复现
model_version_note: 2026-11-06官方文档所列别名指向；记录实际响应model字段，不能声称独立固定了提供方权重
budget_note: 本地按高峰单价与已返回usage估计，不是平台硬扣费上限；未知用量停止，SDK不自动重试
split_unit: question_id (all prefixes, clean/attack variants and defensive arms stay in the same split)
attack_assignment: pre-seeded per-question random two attacker IDs; fixed within paired arms
wrong_target_assignment: pre-seeded incorrect option per question; fixed within paired arms
label_target: initial_attackers_only; dynamic answer error and propagation impact are separate outcome measures
uniform_output_contract: append the same explicit REASON/ANSWER output requirement to every role; record as a prompt-format adaptation
runtime_agent_class: official AgentGraphWithDefense for both arms; no_guard never sets predicted block roles
node_features: mean of this agent's available utterance embeddings through the current phase; no system-prompt features
edge_convention: A[source,target]=1; edge_attr uses source broadcast utterance history through the current phase
runtime_graph: outgoing edges from already blocked sources are absent; same builder used in train/val/inference
training_graphs: all available R0/R1/R2/R3 prefixes; batches bucketed by history length without future padding
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation loss only; test untouched until models fixed
runtime_model: primary_seed only; other seeds are offline sensitivity checks
guard_action: cumulative sender filtering through official set_role('attacker'); does not alter true initial_attackers
uncertainty: question-level paired bootstrap 95% intervals; exploratory n=16 held-out questions
completion_criteria: new live communication has valid parsing and next-round fields
normal and attacked episodes, source hashes and question-disjoint split manifest exist
real MiniLM embeddings and trained original MyGAT checkpoint with reproducible histories exist
four live held-out conditions and per-question/per-round raw outputs exist
raw predictions and outcomes reproduce all reported metrics
teaching report explains the five stages, deviations, failures, cost and rerun instructions
independent implementation and result review completed
negative_result_policy: No improvement is retained and explained; never select favorable test cases or seeds. Experiment completion does not prove the paper's effect replicated.
price_note_for_publication: Historical 2026-11-06 prices only; verify provider pricing before any new paid run.
